cards.name: Save Point
cards.oracleText:
When this enchantment enters, draw a card.
Sacrifice this enchantment: Remove each creature from combat and untap each creature that attacked this turn. There is an additional combat phase after this one. Activate only during combat before combat damage has been dealt.

cards.name: Saved by the Shell
cards.oracleText:
This spell costs {1} less to cast if you control a Turtle.
Put a +1/+1 counter on target creature you control. It gains trample, hexproof, and indestructible until end of turn.

cards.name: Save Life
cards.oracleText:
Choose one —
• Target player gains 2½ life.
• Prevent the next 2½ damage that would be dealt to target creature this turn.
Gotcha — If an opponent says "save" or "life," you may say "Gotcha!" When you do, return Save Life from your graveyard to your hand.
